Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 14, "heading": "CHAPTER XII", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u014-r0014", "target": "— Где ваш благородный отец? — спросил он Леонсию. — У меня для него добрые вести. За неделю, что я вас не видел, я успел переболеть лихорадкой и простоять лагерем. Но с быстрыми гонцами и попутными ветрами через лагуну Чирики до Бокас-дель-Торо я воспользовался правительственным беспроволочным телеграфом — хефе Бокас-дель-Торо мой друг — и связался с президентом Панамы, моим давним товарищем, которому я не реже совал нос в грязь, чем он мне, в мальчишеские дни, когда мы были школьными товарищами и соседями по спальне в Колоне. И пришёл ответ, что всё хорошо; что правосудие в суде Сан-Антонио дало сбой по причине чрезмерного, но оттого не менее похвального рвения хефе политико; и что всё прощено, помиловано и навсегда юридически и политически забыто в отношении всего благородного семейства Солано и их двух благородных друзей-гринго…", "source_sha256": "4f11ac00a91bf22d999154711e5999737577e3cef77819ba37b1a9917a465a24", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u014-r0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c56062f01fbcd66c1a0da09565b976065456554fd9956522dd1b79e2af47deb0"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u014-r0015", "target": "Тут асьендадо низко поклонился Генри и Фрэнсису. И тут, за спиной дяди Леонсии, где тот прятался, взгляд его случайно упал на пеона; и, упав на него, глаза его вспыхнули торжеством.", "source_sha256": "6825d71b229f2a4bffd4fca70eab95ea06716e6484c4c251dfd62d12e41294bb", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u014-r0015", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c36feb5598799e0e3636f0faa9b5ab383b3fcb584e4f32a9292c33adc0d6054b"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u014-r0016", "tag": "p", "text": "“Mother of God, thou has not forgotten me!” he breathed fervently, then turned to the several friends who accompanied him. “There he is, the creature without reason or shame who has fled his debt of me. Seize him! I shall put him on his back for a month from the beating he shall receive!”", "sha256": "c7a6ff4bdb116cd2510d3b54323999ef00674f9627abacc5fa7276859aa796d9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1092]", "source_html": "

“Mother of God, thou has not forgotten me!” he breathed fervently, then turned to the several friends who accompanied him. “There he is, the creature without reason or shame who has fled his debt of me. Seize him! I shall put him on his back for a month from the beating he shall receive!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0017", "tag": "p", "text": "So speaking, the haciendado sprang around the rump of Leoncia’s mule; and the peon, ducking under the mule’s nose, would have won to the freedom of the jungle, had not another of the haciendados, with quick spurs to his horse’s sides, cut him off and run him down. In a trice, used to just such work, the haciendados had the luckless wight on his feet, his hands tied behind him, a lead-rope made fast around his neck.", "sha256": "cddb306194e39930db067536aad46773bf24fb0418967ec6664ba6140c061ae6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1093]", "source_html": "

So speaking, the haciendado sprang around the rump of Leoncia’s mule; and the peon, ducking under the mule’s nose, would have won to the freedom of the jungle, had not another of the haciendados, with quick spurs to his horse’s sides, cut him off and run him down. In a trice, used to just such work, the haciendados had the luckless wight on his feet, his hands tied behind him, a lead-rope made fast around his neck.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "In one voice Francis and Henry protested.", "sha256": "f35536fd8a09a126d1b33c0e1587f521a07c30d7a602e361ac8460fffbd16543", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1094]", "source_html": "

In one voice Francis and Henry protested.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“Senors,” the haciendado replied, “my respect and consideration and desire to serve you are as deep as for the noble Solano family under whose protection you are. Your safety and comfort are sacred to me. I will defend you from harm with my life. I am yours to command. My hacienda is yours, likewise all I possess. But this matter of this peon is entirely another matter. He is none of yours. He is [[I]]my[[/I]] peon, in [[I]]my[[/I]] debt, who has run away from [[I]]my[[/I]] hacienda. You will understand and forgive me, I trust. This is a mere matter of property. He is [[I]]my[[/I]] property.”", "sha256": "81124f618748adba01f0a2656d07df35c35fe7db936b23ccc0e0e6500d89cdc3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1095]", "source_html": "

“Senors,” the haciendado replied, “my respect and consideration and desire to serve you are as deep as for the noble Solano family under whose protection you are. Your safety and comfort are sacred to me. I will defend you from harm with my life. I am yours to command. My hacienda is yours, likewise all I possess. But this matter of this peon is entirely another matter. He is none of yours. He is my peon, in my debt, who has run away from my hacienda. You will understand and forgive me, I trust. This is a mere matter of property. He is my property.”

", "emphasis_spans": 4}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "Henry and Francis glanced at each other in mutual perplexity and indecision. It was the law of the land, as they thoroughly knew.", "sha256": "0f5d4e7fbde7e9bb28371517e6f332bc9d09380e64e5324b931466d05877976b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1096]", "source_html": "

Henry and Francis glanced at each other in mutual perplexity and indecision. It was the law of the land, as they thoroughly knew.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“The Cruel Just One did remit my debt, as all here will witness,” the peon whispered.", "sha256": "bd787fc4ddf3df4f70f6d4b45c3ac2fded91e8515465586f6686af80c5a73360", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1097]", "source_html": "

“The Cruel Just One did remit my debt, as all here will witness,” the peon whispered.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is true, the Cruel Justice remitted his debt,” Leoncia verified.", "sha256": "95f4593186e0c459adce5d857dab851c513f6a938092baad2e5c880c399afb74", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1098]", "source_html": "

“It is true, the Cruel Justice remitted his debt,” Leoncia verified.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "The haciendado smiled and bowed low.", "sha256": "95abbf8a41c78a84038298a0ea982fff73517221343a587f9370ef6ba06df514", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1099]", "source_html": "

120The haciendado smiled and bowed low.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“But the peon contracted with me,” he smiled. “And who is the Blind Brigand that his foolish law shall operate on my plantation and rob me of my rightful two hundred and fifty pesos?”", "sha256": "9cbe754aaa351c94e3c29039ed6542f67a1121304d15de5142f033ea4b64bf9a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1100]", "source_html": "

“But the peon contracted with me,” he smiled. “And who is the Blind Brigand that his foolish law shall operate on my plantation and rob me of my rightful two hundred and fifty pesos?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“He’s right, Leoncia,” Henry admitted.", "sha256": "7a85cf2aae33b3b0eda4397702532bdb700fb800b6e8e97b428aaf07a354eeaa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1101]", "source_html": "

“He’s right, Leoncia,” Henry admitted.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“Then will I go back to the high Cordilleras,” the peon asserted. “Oh, you men of the Cruel Just One, take me back to the Cordilleras.”", "sha256": "ee4bf83c9a3f7bde47f566e3163b2265635f7efcddf6b7d0cd92441337430cfd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1102]", "source_html": "

“Then will I go back to the high Cordilleras,” the peon asserted. “Oh, you men of the Cruel Just One, take me back to the Cordilleras.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "But the stern leader shook his head.", "sha256": "29ffbf7052e64736a22fea45ac77c380846b285d59f85b300e2638521e4e64c2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1103]", "source_html": "

But the stern leader shook his head.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“Here you were released. Our orders went no further. No further jurisdiction have we over you. We shall now bid farewell and depart.”", "sha256": "f370ef91aafdfc535529c5b8c278e8570a9a6e9c7fbd51921279bcea0e152899", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1104]", "source_html": "

“Here you were released. Our orders went no further. No further jurisdiction have we over you. We shall now bid farewell and depart.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Hold on!” Francis cried, pulling out his check book and beginning to write. “Wait a moment. I must settle for this peon now. Next, before you depart, I have a favor to ask of you.”", "sha256": "594b1ce276b0adcb6aec3a3954c5e17d68452f01b675ed4b4a9dfeb39fa4f5f8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1105]", "source_html": "

“Hold on!” Francis cried, pulling out his check book and beginning to write. “Wait a moment. I must settle for this peon now. Next, before you depart, I have a favor to ask of you.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0030", "tag": "p", "text": "He passed the check to the haciendado, saying:", "sha256": "18201efbfd3d0472c60ba32f08f5823870c12fd4cf868b4b3ed58b8e849d075a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1106]", "source_html": "

He passed the check to the haciendado, saying:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u014-r0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“I have allowed ten pesos for the exchange.”", "sha256": "62b7caf5ef9f900114206677aaaf1903350c330262d60ab4700dfd9bfc2702db", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1107]", "source_html": "

“I have allowed ten pesos for the exchange.”
